{
  "mode": "CUSTOM",
  "instruction": "Generate a Git commit message for the given stashed or staged changes, strictly following the Conventional Commits specification (v1.0.0).

Guidelines:
- Language: English.
- Format: <type>[optional scope]: <description>
- Use a short, imperative, present-tense description (e.g., "add", "fix", "change", not "added" or "adds").
- Do not capitalize the first letter of the description.
- No period at the end of the commit line.
- Allowed types: feat, fix, docs, style, refactor, perf, test, build, ci, chore, revert.
- Include a scope in parentheses if the changes are localized to a specific module or component.
- Keep the first line under 72 characters.
- If there is a breaking change, append '!' after the type/scope (e.g., "feat(api)!: remove deprecated endpoint") or explain it in a footer.
- Output ONLY the raw commit message, without markdown backticks or commentary."
}
